entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm... I'm a bit lost. I ordered a jersey, and I think I need to send it back, but the website is just so confusing. I don't know what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. Not a problem at all. Just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a sizing preference?
Oh, it's the size. I must have ordered the wrong size because it's way too tight across the shoulders. I'm not sure if I should return it or get an exchange or what the policy even is.
I see. So it's a fit issue, not a problem with the jersey itself. Let me just pull up our policy for you. Can I get your order number?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I got it about a month ago, I think. Am I too late? Can't you just help me?

I'm looking at your order now. It looks like it was delivered 31 days ago. For a standard item like this jersey, our return policy is 10 days, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe for a return or an exchange.
Oh, 10 days? That's a huge relief! I was so worried I was stuck with a jersey that was too tight. So you can help me with an exchange right now?

Absolutely. Since you just need a different size, I can process that exchange for you immediately. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label to send back the one that's the wrong size. What size did you need instead?
Thank you so much! I'd like a Large, please. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome. I've just sent that label to your email on file and put the order in for the size Large. You should see it in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Isaac.
